notes: JESD204 characterization centers on the SerDes lane eye and CDR, the CGS/ILAS bring-up, multi-lane skew within the multiframe/elastic-buffer budget, and (Subclass 1/2) SYSREF/SYNC~ deterministic-latency timing. Per-device PHY calibration is done at bring-up.
ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Per-lane data eye
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the differential CML lane meets the eye/jitter budget at the target rate (up to 12.5 Gbps 204B / 32 Gbps 204C).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: CDR lock / comma alignment
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the receiver CDR locks and aligns on /K28.5/ during CGS.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: ILAS / FCHK
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate the four-multiframe ILAS content and the configuration checksum.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Deterministic latency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure repeatable converter-to-logic latency across power cycles in Subclass 1/2 (SYSREF/SYNC~ aligned LMFC).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SYSREF setup/hold vs Device Clock
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify SYSREF is sampled correctly by DEVCLK for LMFC alignment.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Multi-lane skew
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm lanes align to a common multiframe boundary within the elastic-buffer budget.
